svg.title: Complete two-input learning circuit
svg.desc: All 84 devices in blobs.cir: two class readouts and six weight cells. Matching net labels connect across panels.
svg.text: 74 MOSFETs + 6 capacitors + 4 resistors. Read each class column downward; matching blue net labels connect across all panels.
MOS: D = drain, S = source; gate enters from left. Bubble = PMOS. Bodies: nch/syn → 0, pch → vdd.
0 = ground. Named bias, input, target, reset and learn ports are driven by the runner; its sources/loads are not shown.
10 transistors + 2 resistors. All three weight cells share n_pos / n_neg / n_error for this class.
